title: EncounterCatalog
description: Version 2: a party and an enemy group on a visible turn timeline (decision 0006), placed on a 3 × 3 grid per side (decision 0014; all grid fields are optional).

opening.description: How the fight opens (decision 0014). back-attack: the enemy attacks the party from its rear. pincer: enemies on both sides; each enemy then needs a flank. Default normal.

cell.description: Grid cell (decision 0014). lane: 1 top to 3 bottom; depth: 1 front to 3 back. A side places all its fighters or none; unplaced sides fill the front column top to bottom, then the middle, then the back. A big enemy's cell is its top front corner.

size.description: Enemies only: how many lanes and depths a big enemy covers. Default 1 × 1.

reach.description: melee: front-facing targets only; reach (spears, whips, polearms): one layer deeper; ranged (bows, spells): anyone. Default melee.

flank.description: Pincer encounters only, and required there: which side of the party this enemy attacks from. Each flank has its own grid.
